# B - Soft solid

User-selected flat logo icons. Original SVG geometry exported to transparent PNGs, with consistent lavender silhouettes and a plain pale-blue widget surface. No textures, shadows or detailed illustrations. Android and iOS bundle identical source PNGs; selected bottom tabs tint them white for contrast.

Native builds use committed images. For design exports, run mobile/tools/export-soft-solid.cjs with sharp available. The previous generated illustration originals remain in dist/assets/artwork.
